name: Shibasaki Tomori
source:
A shy, unassuming girl who tries her best to never stand out, Tomori seems like the last person to run for president. But behind her meek and mild exterior lies the heart of a girl who just wants to experience her youth to the fullest.

Will her earnest resolve pull her through, or has she set her sights a little too high?
